reason: A is more convincing to me as a wary backer. It says most of the 8.1 rating came from people who played at the creator's table, does the budget math out loud (about $25,350 in costs against the $28,000 goal) and gives a firm November date. B has unfilled placeholders, a vague 'small buffer' and implies the ratings came from strangers, so it feels like the polished pitch that burned me before.
